about_the_game:
A fast-paced arena shooter where you battle as wacky food characters! Face off in intense PvP matches or team up in PvE against crazy food enemies. Quick matches, ridiculous weapons, and spicy action await!

Fast food just got faster!

In this fast-paced, action-packed multiplayer game, food has come to life—and it’s out for delivery! Choose your team: Guards, responsible for delivering tasty packages from their restaurants, or Thieves, who will do anything to stop them. Every round, the roles switch, the weapons change, and the chaos intensifies!

Key Features:

  • 🍕 Food Fighters: Play as quirky food characters like pizza, hot dogs, chili peppers, cupcakes, and more!

  • 🚚 Delivery or Disruption: Work as a team to deliver or sabotage the orders.

  • 🔫 Wacky Weapons: Each round brings new weapons, keeping the action fresh and unpredictable.

  • 🏙 City Mayhem: Navigate a cartoonish city full of moving cars, obstacles, and opportunities for mischief.

  •  🎮 Solo, Co-op & Multiplayer: Play against bots or team up with friends.

  • 😂 Pure Chaos: A mix of comedy, speed, and absurd action—because food fights should be taken seriously!

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate food champion? Get ready to deliver, dodge, and dominate!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (latest Service Pack)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Octa-core Intel or AMD, 3.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

short_description: Play as quirky, crazy food characters in this chaotic single or multiplayer action game! Deliver orders as Guards or sabotage as Thieves. Roles switch, weapons change, and madness escalates! Play solo, or in teams with friends in a wacky city full of obstacles, cars and food-fighting mayhem!
